title: Predictive Modeling, Threshold Optimization, and Explainable Risk Scoring for Retail Bank Customer Churn
description: An open-access empirical research manuscript and reproducible machine learning framework for predictive customer churn intelligence in retail banking. Evaluated on 10,000 multi-market European bank customers across France, Germany, and Spain. Features cost-sensitive threshold calibration, precision-recall optimization, bootstrap confidence intervals, and explainable AI under regulatory compliance frameworks (Basel III & EU AI Act).
notes: Comprehensive empirical research study and production intelligence application for retail banking customer retention.
